thread:
deploy-bot: ALERT: post-deploy canary in us-east-1: 3xx/5xx spike and p95 latency up >3x. paging on-call. service: inference-runtime, tag: release/2026-03-15.

nina (on-call): on it. thanks. which canary group?

alex (sre): canary group: canary-v2-east, ~5% of traffic. 5m window: error-rate 8.4% (baseline 0.3%), p95 2300ms (baseline 600ms). CPU/GPU utilization normal.

maya (eng): i pushed a tiny eviction tweak earlier (commit abc1234) that changes KV cache TTL heuristics. landing was during the canary window. i'll take a look.

sam (pm): tagging customer-impacted lists now. julie can you start a holding message for potential customer comms?

oj: @julie (cs) yep — prepping.

oscar (infra): temp mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag that enables new eviction logic 2) rollback single commit 3) scale canary down to 0. prefer flag kill for fastest turnaround.

nina (on-call): agree. flag kill first. please post the admin command. i'll run it and confirm.

oscar (infra): use internal flags API:

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  https://flags.internal.redwood/api/v1/feature/kv-eviction/disable \ 
  -d '{"env":"production","target":"canary-v2-east"}'
```

oscar (infra): response should be 200 + {"status":"disabled"}. that will short-circuit to old eviction path for canary group only.

nina (on-call): running now...

nina (on-call): executed. response: 200 {"status":"disabled"} :white_check_mark:. metrics window started updating.

sre-bot: ALERT UPDATE: canary-v2-east error-rate reduced to 3.1% within 90s. p95 down to 1.1s.

alex (sre): good improvement but still higher than baseline. recommend revert as backup if not fully recovered in 5-10m. maya, can you prepare a single-commit revert PR for abc1234? keep it minimal.

maya (eng): on it, creating revert PR now. will include a small patch and a smoke-test job.

julie (cs): drafting customer note: "We observed elevated errors/latency for a small subset of requests in us-east-1 after a canary deploy. We have temporarily disabled the new eviction behavior and are monitoring. No data loss reported. We will follow up after stabilization." any edits?

sam (pm): that sounds right. include timeline and affected percentage (~5% of traffic) and that we disabled feature and will revert the change if needed.

maya (eng): PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/commit/revert-abc1234 (PR #2345). running CI.

sre-bot: CI passed for PR #2345.

maya (eng): merging revert now. commands:

```bash
git revert --no-commit abc1234 && git commit -m "revert: restore previous kv-ttl heuristics (revert abc1234)" && git push origin main
```

maya (eng): merged and triggered canary rollout of reverted binary to canary-v2-east.

sre-bot: DEPLOY: revert-abc1234 deployed to canary-v2-east at 2026-03-15T21:18:45Z.

alex (sre): metrics: 3m after revert, error-rate 0.7%, p95 680ms. looks back to baseline.

nina (on-call): observed stabilization. leaving canary at reduced traffic for 30m to validate. will escalate if anything regresses.

julie (cs): sending customer note now. draft posted in #customer-outreach: "We disabled a new behavior for a small percentage of traffic in us-east-1 and reverted the change. Services are stable. We're investigating root cause and will share a postmortem."

sam (pm): thanks. set incident severity to sev2 (service degradation limited to canary group; mitigated). add follow-up: root-cause analysis, stronger canary checks for TTL changes, and operator playbook update.

nina (on-call): agreed. i'll open a formal incident ticket and assign RCA to eng/observability. temporary follow-ups: 1) keep feature off globally until patch + perf regression tests added 2) add a rollout guard for eviction/ttl heuristics 3) update console alert thresholds for p95 spikes on new canaries.

maya (eng): noted. i'll own the patch and the RCA writeup. thanks for quick responses everyone.

alex (sre): adding retrospective note: consider circuit-breaker fallback for KV miss storms to avoid cascading latency.

nina (on-call): closing the active page. monitoring window started. will update thread after 30m or earlier if needed. :latency::white_check_mark:

sre-bot: INCIDENT: resolved (mitigated) — canary rollback and feature disable complete. follow-ups recorded in INC-2026-0315-42.
